summary: Li Auto Inc. filed Form 6-K with Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Returns (May 19-22, 2026) reporting share repurchases. On May 18, 2026, the company repurchased 1,440,844 A ordinary shares at USD 8.3742 per share (volume-weighted average), representing 0.0801% of outstanding shares, held as treasury shares (not cancelled). Opening balance was 1,799,443,153 issued shares; closing balance after repurchase was 1,798,002,309 issued shares plus 10,421,360 treasury shares. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is a capital return to shareholders via open-market buyback. Watch for ongoing repurchase program activity and potential cancellation of treasury shares.
